meta.name: reconcile
meta.description: 128 F-reconciliation (jav/reconcile.py): which bank statement line paid which incoming invoice, by code. The invoice types, the payment window, the signal thresholds, the payment kinds left to a person and when a statement counts as verified coverage. Decisions: DECISIONS 128 (exact amount and at least one signal first; card payments with an exchange rate later; never 'unpaid').

changelog.note: 130 K3: card payments of foreign-currency invoices (DECISIONS 128 variant C, second half). A forint line of a credit card statement and an invoice in another currency form a candidate when a signal ties them and the line falls in fx.window around the issue date; the invoice amount is converted at the MNB rate of the issue date (jav/fx.py) and the pair is proposed when the line is within policy.json reconcile.fx_tolerance. Without a known rate the pair is listed, not proposed (status rate_missing). The card accounts also count in the coverage of a foreign-currency invoice.

128 K1: first version. Rules ported selectively from the legacy project's orchestrator/framework/payables.py 0.1.1 (10_AIFLOW_V4 HEAD 4256cba): the reason-coded exclusions, the signals and 'an equal amount alone is no candidate'. New: the exact-amount rule, the window's upper end, coverage by verified statements.
